purpose: Candidate-independent outcomes for a graph-selected hypothetical source-observation-time branch, kept separate from the unchanged source-time mainline.
oracle_policy: Values are pinned only from the approved planner packet and byte-frozen accepted source oracles. Candidate query, fixture, endpoint, UI, browser, or verifier output never supplies or amends expected values.

scope.hypothetical_branch_fact: The branch alone assumes observed_at 2026-10-14T16:06:00Z; this is not a corrected source fact or reporting-delay finding.
scope.graph_semantics: The branch is selected through ScenarioBranch -[:HAS_HYPOTHETICAL_OBSERVATION]-> ObservationOverride -[:FOR_SOURCE]-> Evidence; each edge is required.
scope.unknown_semantics: Missing branch/source evidence is unknown/incomplete, never evidence for fallback, nonexistence, conflict absence, resolution, current ownership, or safety.
scope.acl_semantics: The complete operations API/browser/accessibility projection is invariant under disconnected-decoy and connected restricted-only injection; inaccessible facts, identifiers, counts, relationships, paths, existence, or paraphrases do not leak.

test_setup_only.note: These synthetic tripwires exist only to test non-disclosure and are not expected visible values.
